scenario: Two TTL facts of the same schema with the same slot values asserted in sequence; advancing past the deadline and pumping leaves none (LFAC.1.3.3; RARC.5.2.4). The vector has one count, at the end, so it does not tell whether the second assert made a second fact (LFAC.1.3.2) or was suppressed (RARC.5.2.3): it pins the expiry only. It makes a second fact; runtime/LFAC.1.3.2_identical_ttl_asserts_accumulate and temporal/RARC.5.2.3_identical_ttl_asserts_expire_apart pin that.
rules_ds:
schema Pulse scope ttl 100_ms:
    v: Int
